name: Incline Bench Press
cues: Bench at 30 degrees, bar to upper chest.

name: Incline Press
cues: Bench at 30 degrees, control the way down.

name: Flat Dumbbell Fly
cues: Slight elbow bend, stretch wide, squeeze up.

name: Machine Incline Press
cues: Seat so handles line up with upper chest.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cues: Back on the pad, press straight up.

name: Lateral Raise
cues: Lead with the elbows, stop at shoulder height.

name: Triceps Pushdown
cues: Pin elbows to your sides.

name: Skull Crushers
cues: Elbows still, lower to the forehead. Then 15-20 min easy cardio.

name: Lat Pulldown
cues: Pull elbows down to your ribs.

name: T-Bar Row
cues: Flat back, pull to your lower chest.

name: Seated Row
cues: Sit tall, squeeze your shoulder blades.

name: Face Pull
cues: Pull to your forehead, elbows high.

name: Dumbbell Shrugs
cues: Straight up and down, pause at the top.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curls
cues: Palms up, no swinging.

name: Preacher Curls
cues: Upper arms flat on the pad, full stretch. Then 15-20 min easy cardio.

name: Squat
cues: Brace first, knees track over toes.

name: Leg Extension
cues: Pause and squeeze at the top.

name: Leg Press
cues: Lower back stays on the pad.

name: Leg Curl
cues: Slow on the way back up.

name: Walking Lunges
cues: Long steps, back knee nearly touches. Reps are steps.

name: Calf Raise
cues: Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top.

name: Back Extension
cues: Hinge at the hips, stop when your body is straight. Then 15-20 min easy cardio.

name: Bench Press
cues: Elbows at 45 degrees, bar to mid chest.

name: Shoulder Press
cues: Ribs down, press straight overhead.

name: Cable Fly
cues: Slight elbow bend, squeeze at the middle.

name: Barbell Row
cues: Flat back, pull to your lower chest.

name: Hammer Curl
cues: Palms facing in, no swinging.

name: Barbell Curl
cues: Keep elbows still at your sides.

name: Romanian Deadlift
cues: Hips back, soft knees, flat back.
